senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (इ) ग्रथि (ग्रन्थते)
1 To be crooked.
2 To be crooked metaphorically, to be wicked.
2 To curve, to bend or make crooked.
3 To string together, to arrange.
r. 10th cl. (ग्रन्थयति)
To bind or tie.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Strung, tied together or in order.
2 Collected.
3 Arranged, classed.
4 Overcome.
5 Hurt, injured.
E.
ग्रथि to bind, affix क्त.

r. 1st, 9th and 10th cls. (ग्रन्थति ग्रथ्नाति ग्रन्थयति)
To string, to tie together, to connect or arrange in a regular series.
With उद् prefixed,
To untie, to loosen.

m. (-न्थः)
1 Stringing or tying together, (literally or metaphorically.)
2 Wealth, property.
3 A book or composition in prose or verse.
4 A metre or measure of thirty-two syllables.
E.
ग्रन्थ to dispose or arrange, affix अच्.

m. (-र्त्ता)
An author.
E.
ग्रन्थ, and कर्त्तृ maker.

m. (-रः)
An author.
E.
ग्रन्थ, and कार who makes.

f. (-टी)
An office, a study, a library.
E.
ग्रन्थ a book, and कुटी a house or room.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Arranging, stringing, tying or connecting together either as a chaplet or a book.
E.
ग्रन्थ to arrange, affix युच्.

m. (-रः)
A voluminous work.
E.
ग्रन्थ, and विस्तर extent.

m. (-न्थिः)
1 The joint or knot of a reed or cane, &c.
2 A tie, the knot of a cord, &c.
3 A joint or articulation of the body.
4 A plant, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण.
5 Crookedness, distortion.
6 A complaint, knotting of the vessels as in varicocele, &c.
E.
ग्रन्थ to connect, &c. Uṇādi affix इन्.

m. (-कः)
1 An astrologer, a fortune teller.
2 The youngest of the Pāṇḍus.
3 A thorny plant: see करीर.
n. (-कं)
1 The root of long pepper.
2 A kind of resin, Bdellium.
3 A perfume: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण.
E.
कन् added to the preceding, or ग्रन्थ a book, &c. and ठक् aff.

n. (-कं)
The root of long pepper: see ग्रन्थिक.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Strung, tied.
E.
ग्रन्थ to tie, affix क्त.

f. (-र्व्वा)
A species of Dūrvā grass.
E.
ग्रन्थि, and दूर्व्वा Panicum dactylon.

mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि)
1 Bookish, read, learned.
2 Relating or belonging to a book, &c.
E.
ग्रन्थ, and इनि aff.

m. (-र्णः)
A plant, and according to some authorities a perfume, commonly called Ganṭhiāla.
E.
ग्रन्थ a knot, and पर्ण a leaf.

n. (-नं)
1 Tying a knot.
2 A ligament.
3 Tying together the garments of the bride and bridegroom at the marriage ceremony.
E.
ग्रन्थि, and बन्धन binding.

m. (-मान्)
A plant, (Heliotropium indicum); also अस्थिसंहार.
E.
ग्रन्थि knot, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-लं)
Garlic.
E.
ग्रन्थि, a knot, and मूल root.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Knotted, knotty, &c.
m. (-लः)
1 A plant, commonly Buïñci (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.)
2 Karīr, a thorny plant, (Capparis): see करीर.
n. (-लं)
1 Green or undried ginger.
2 Root of long pepper.
E.
ग्रन्थि a knot, and लच् aff.

m. (-र्ही)
A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण.
E.
ग्रन्थि a knot, वर्ह to cover, and णिनि aff.

m. (-रः)
A counsellor, a minister.
E.
ग्रन्थि a knot, and हर who removes; who unites the knots of business.

r. 1st cl. (उ) ग्रसु (ग्रसते)
1 To eat.
2 To swallow, to devour.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (ग्रसति ग्रासयति)
To take, to seize.

m. (-सः)
A mouthful or a quantity equivalent to a mouthful, a lump of rice, &c. of the size of a peacock's egg.
E.
ग्रस to eat, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Swallowing, eating.
2 Taking, seizing.
E.
ग्रस to take, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Swallowing, devouring.
2 Receiving or listening to any thing eagerly.
E.
ग्रस to eat, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Eating, taking food.
E.
ग्रस to eat, इष्णुच् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Inarticulately pronounced, slurred, uttered with the omission of a letter or syllable.
2 Eaten.
3 Taken, seized.
4 Affected by.
5 Commenced as an eclipse, eclipsed.
E.
ग्रस to eat, affix क्त.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Commenced and ended as an eclipse.
E.
ग्रस्त seized, अस्त set.

r. 1st, and 10th cls. (ग्रहति ग्रहयति) r. 9th cl. (ऊ) ग्रहू (गृह्णाति गृह्णीते)
1 To take, to seize, to receive or accept.
With अनु prefixed,
To favour, to shew kindness to.
With अव,
To oppose.
With उत्,
To deposit, to trust.
With उप,
To provide.
2 To favour.
With नि,
1 To take, to arrest.
2 To punish.
3 To restrain.
With परि,
To lay hold of, to seize.
With प्रति,
1 To assent to, to receive as a precept or truth.
2 To embrace, to enfold, to comprehend or contain.
3 To subdue.
4 To accept.
With वि,
To quarrel, to fight.
With सम्,
To collect, to assemble.

m. (-हः)
1 Taking, whether by seizure or acceptance.
2 An eclipse or seizure of the sun or moon, by RĀHU, &c.
3 A planet.
4 The place of a planet in the fixed zodiac.
5 A moveable point in the heavens.
6 A name of RĀHU, or the ascending node.
7 An imp, one of a particular class, beginning with PŪTANĀ, supposed especially to seize upon young children, producing convulsions.
8 Effort in battle.
9 Tenacity, perseverance.
10 Purpose, design.
11 Favor, patronage.
E.
ग्रह to take, &c. affix अप्.

m. (-हः)
1 Taking, either by seizure or acceptance.
2 A shark; according to some, the Gangetic alligator, (Lacerta Gangetica); according to others, the water elephant, (the hippopotamus?)
3 Any large fish or marine animal.
E.
ग्रह to take, affix घञ् or ण.

m. (-लः)
A name of RĀHU, the personified ascending node.
E.
ग्रह a planet, and कल्लोल an enemy.

m. (-णः)
The planets taken collectively.
E.
ग्रह, and गण a number.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
A prisoner, captive, confined.
n. (-णं)
1 Taking, seizure.
2 Receiving, acceptance.
3 Assent, agreement.
4 Respect.
5 The hand.
6 An eclipse.
7 Comprehension, the taking or receiving of instruction, or the acquirement of any science.
8 Sound.
9 An organ of sense.
10 In grammar, Exception.
E.
ग्रह to take, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-न्तं)
Close of study, acquirement of science, &c.
E.
ग्रहण taking, and अन्त end.

n. (-कं)
Termination of holy study.
E.
ग्रहण, and अन्तिक final.

f. (-णिः)
1 Diarrhoea, dysentery.
2 The vessels diffusing vital warmth.
3 The small intestines, that part of the alimentary canal where the bile assists digestion.
E.
ग्रह to seize, अनि Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added ग्रहणी.

f. (-रुक्)
Diarrhoea, dysentery.
E.
ग्रहणी the same (as above), and रुज् sickness, disease.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be taken, to be seized, accepted, &c.
E.
ग्रह, and अनीयर् aff.

n. (-रं)
Cloves.
E.
ग्रहणी diarrhoea, and हर what removes.

m. (-कः)
1 The sun.
2 The planet Saturn.
E.
ग्रह a planet, and नायक a chief.

m. (-शः)
A plant, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
ग्रह taking, and नाश injury, producing pain in the bowels, &c. also ग्रहनाशन.

m. (-मिः)
The moon.
E.
ग्रह a planet, and नेमि the circumference of a wheel, from its shape.

m. (-तिः)
The sun.
E.
ग्रह a planet, and पति chief.

f. (-डा)
The influence of an unpropitious planet.
E.
ग्रह, and पीडा pain.

m. (-षः)
The sun.
E.
ग्रह, and पुष to cherish, affix क; cherishing the planets with his light.

f. (-जा)
Worship of the sun and the other planets.
E.
ग्रह, and पूजा worship.

m. (-गः)
Worship of or offering to the planets.
E.
ग्रह, and याग sacrifice; also ग्रहयज्ञ.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Taking, receiving.
E.
ग्रह to take, आलुच् affix, अय inserted; also गृहयालु.

m. (-जः)
1 The sun.
2 The moon.
3 The planet Jupiter or its regent.
E.
ग्रह a planet, and राज a king, a chief.

m. (-प्रः)
An astrologer.
E.
ग्रह, and विप्र a Brahman.

m. (-रः)
The constellation DHRUVA or the polar star.
E.
ग्रह planet, and आधार asylum; the star remaining fixed amidst the planetary movements.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Subject to planetary influence.
E.
ग्रह, and अधीन dependant.

m. (-यः)
Epilepsy, convulsions, demoniac possession which the complaint is supposed to be.
E.
ग्रह an imp, and आमय sickness.

m. (-शी)
A plant, (Echites scholaris): see ग्रहनाश.
E.
ग्रह taking, and अश here meaning to hurt, affix इनि.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be taken or accepted.
2 To be learned or acquired.
E.
ग्रह to take, तव्य affix, and ई inserted.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Taking, disposed to take.
E.
ग्रह to take, तृच् affix, and ई inserted.

m. (-मः)
1 A village, a hamlet, an inhabited and unfortified place in the midst of fields and meadow land, where men of [] the servile class mostly reside, and where agriculture thrives.
2 A scale in music.
3 (In composition.) A multitude.
E.
गम to go, affix घञ् and deriv. irr. or ग्रस to eat, Uṇādi affix मन् and आच् substituted for the radical final.

m. (-टः)
A tame or domestic cock.
E.
ग्राम, and कुक्कुट a cock.

m. (-टः)
A man of the fourth tribe, a Śūdra.
E.
ग्राम a village, and कूट a number, the crowd or population of the village.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Who or what goes to a village.
E.
ग्राम, and गम to go, ड aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going in or to a village.
E.
ग्राम, and गमिन् who goes.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
Being or remaining outside the village.
E.
ग्राम, and गृह्य to be taken out.

m. (-तः)
Plundering a village.
E.
ग्राम, and धात attacking.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Who or what goes to a village.
E.
ग्राम in the 2d case, गमिन् what goes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Village, rustic, village-born or produced.
E.
ग्राम, and ज born; also ग्रामजात, &c.

mfn. (-णीः-णीः-णि)
1 Best, excellent.
2 Chief, pre-eminent, superintendent.
3 One who only thinks of enjoyment.
m. (-णीः)
A barber.
f. (-णीः)
1 A whore, a harlot.
2 A female peasant or villager.
3 The indigo plant.
E.
ग्राम a village, नी to get or obtain, affix क्विप्.

m. (-त्रः)
The son of a whore, a bastard.
E.
ग्रामणी, and पुत्र a son; also read ग्रामणिपुत्र.

m. (-क्षः)
The village carpenter.
E.
ग्राम a village, and तक्ष carpenter.

ind.
From the village.
E.
ग्राम, and तसि aff.

f. (-ता)
A multitude of villages.
E.
ग्राम, and तल् affix of multitude; also ग्रामत्वं with त्व aff.

m. (-शः)
The head of ten villages.
E.
ग्राम, दश ten, and ईश chief; also ग्रामद शाधिपति, &c.

m. (-तः)
The village messenger or servant.
E.
ग्राम, and भृत supported.

f. (-का)
1 A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.)
2 A riot, a fray, a village war, (ग्रामयुद्ध.)
E.
ग्राम, and मद्गुर a fish, &c.

m. (-खः)
A market town, a fair, a market.
E.
ग्राम a village, and मुख chief.

m. (-गः)
A dog.
E.
ग्राम, and मृग a deer, the village deer.

m. (-कः)
The village priest, one who conducts the ceremonies for any or all classes, and is consequently considered as a degraded Brahman; it also applies to the attendant of an idol.
E.
ग्राम a village, यज to sacrifice, in the causal form, affix वुन्; also with णिनि affix ग्रामयाजिन्.

n. (-नं)
Plundering or pillaging a village.
E.
ग्राम, and लुण्टन robbing.

m. (-सः)
1 A villager.
2 Living in a village.
E.
ग्राम, and वास abode; also ग्रामेवास.

m. (-सी)
A villager.
E.
ग्राम, and वासिन् who inhabits; also ग्रामेवासिन्.

m. (-षः)
Variety of the scales in music.
E.
ग्राम, and विशेष difference.

n. (-तं)
A hundred villages, a province.
E.
ग्राम, and शत a hundred.

m. (-शः)
The governor of a province.
E.
ग्राम, शत and ईश chief; also ग्रामशताधिपति, ग्रामशताध्यक्ष, &c.

m. (-रः)
The common sewer or drain of a village.
E.
ग्राम, and सङ्कर a narrow place.

m. (-ङ्घः)
A village corporation, a municipality.
E.
ग्राम, and सङ्घ an assembly.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Being or residing in a village, belonging to it, &c.
m. (-स्थः)
A village.
E.
ग्राम, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-कः)
A sister's husband.
E.
ग्राम a village, and हास who delights, from हस to laugh, &c. and ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
Hunting.
E.
ग्राम a village, and आधान what supports.

m. (-तः)
The head man or chief of a village.
E.
ग्राम, and अधिकृत set over.

m. (-तिः)
Chief or head of a village.
E.
ग्राम, and अधिपति chief.

m. (-क्षः)
Superintendent or chief of a village.
E.
ग्राम, and अध्यक्ष superior.

n. (-न्तं)
Space near a village.
E.
ग्राम, and अन्त a boundary.

m. (-यं)
Space near a village.
E.
ग्राम, and अन्त end, छ aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Village, rude, rustic.
2 Chromatic.
m. (कः)
1 The headman of a village.
2 A village.
E.
ग्राम, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Village, villager.
m. (-मी)
The headman of a village.
f. (-मिनी)
The indigo plant.
E.
ग्राम a village, इनि and ङीष् affixes; also ग्रामीणा.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 A villager, a rustic.
2 Produced in or peculiar to a village.
3 Vulgar, rude.
4 Chromatic.
m. (-णः)
1 A dog.
2 A crow.
f. (-णा)
The indigo plant.
E.
ग्राम, and खञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging to a village, produced in or derived from it.
m. (-यः)
A villager.
E.
ग्राम, and छ affix; also with कन् added ग्रामीयक.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
A villager, rustic, village-born, &c.
E.
ग्राम, and ढक् affix; also with कन् added ग्रामेयक.

m. (-सः)
1 A villager.
2 A village abode.
E.
ग्रामे seventh case, and वास abode.

m. (-सी)
A village.
E.
ग्रामे seventh case, वासिन् who dwells.

m. (-शः)
The headman of a village.
E.
ग्राम, and ईश a master.

m. (-रः)
The headman or ruler over a village.
E.
ग्राम, and ईश्वर a master.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 Village-born, produced in or relating to a village.
2 Vulgar, rude, rustic.
3 Relating to a musical scale.
m. (-म्यः)
A hog, a tame or a village hog.
n. (-म्यं)
1 Rustic or homely speech.
2 The Prākṛta and the other dialects of India, except the Sanscrit.
E.
ग्राम, and यत् aff.

f. (-टी)
A pumpkin gourd.
E.
ग्राम्य village, and कक्कट gourd.

m. (-न्दः)
A common species of Arum.
E.
ग्राम्य, and कन्द root.

n. (-मं)
A yellow dye, safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
E.
ग्राम्य, and कुङ्कुम saffron, village saffron.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Copulation.
E.
ग्राम्य, and धर्म्म virtue, village virtue.

f. (-का)
A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) ग्राममद्गुरिका.

n. (-सं)
Meat of tame animals.
E.
ग्राम्य rural, and मांस fresh^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-गः)
A dog.
E.
ग्राम्य, and मृग a deer, the village deer; also ग्राममृग.

f. (-शिः)
A name of several of the signs of the zodiac.
E.
ग्राम्य, and राशि a sign.

m. (-रः)
A village hog, a tame hog, a pig.
E.
ग्राम्य, and शूकर a hog.

m. (-श्वः)
An ass.
E.
ग्राम्य, and अश्व a horse, the village horse.

mfn. (-वा-वा-व)
Hard, solid.
m. (-वा)
1 A stone or rock.
2 A mountain.
3 A cloud.
E.
ग्रह to seize, वनिप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Bare subsistence, food and clothing.
E.
ग्रास, and आच्छादन covering.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
One who takes or seizes, one who accepts or receives.
m. (-कः)
1 A hawk, a falcon.
2 A police officer, a constable, a bailiff.
E.
ग्रह to take, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Containing or abounding with alligators.
E.
ग्राह, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
1 Taking, seizing, accepting, who or what takes.
2 Astringent, binding, constipating.
m. (-ही)
1 A sedative, a narcotic.
2 The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.
f. (-णी)
A small kind of Javāsa, perhaps a species of Hedysarum.
E.
ग्रह to take, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 To be seized, to be taken, to be accepted.
2 To be accepted as a rule or law, to be acknowledged or assented to.
3 To be attached to or obeyed.
4 To be admitted in evidence, &c.
5 To be apprehended or arrested.
E.
ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
